== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The White [[Fox]], or White [[Fox]] [[madra]], is a specialized energy source and combat style central to the [[Wei clan]] of [[Sacred Valley]]. Inspired by a unique three-tailed [[snowfox]] native to the region, this [[madra]] is composed of light and dream-based [[aura]]. Its primary characteristic is the ability to deceive the senses by manipulating light, sound, and perception through illusions. While legend suggests consuming [[snowfox]] meat can strengthen this specific [[madra]], the [[Path]] itself was established by [[Elder Whisper]]. Practitioners of the [[Path of the White Fox]] utilize various specialized techniques categorized by their role. Forgers use the [[Fox Mirror]] to create lifelike, though unsubstantial, duplicates or disguises. [[Enforcers]] employ the [[Foxtail]] [[technique]] to blur their movements, making their physical strikes and positioning difficult for opponents to [[judge]] accurately. Strikers utilize [[Foxfire|foxfire]]—unextinguishable purple and white flames that inflict pain without causing physical damage—to manipulate light or simulate burning sensations. [[Rulers]] on this [[Path]] act as catalysts, using their energy to trap enemies within a [[Fox Dream]]. Additionally, specialized boundary formations can be constructed using seven banners to gather light and [[dream aura]] for training or deception.}}
